name: r0_blockev_half
description: r0_poss_half with the whole block-EV family halved (reward_k_kd 0.1 -> 0.05, reward_k_value 0.5 -> 0.25, reward_k_ball 0.15 -> 0.075, reward_k_seq 0.03 -> 0.015, reward_k_turnover 0.15 -> 0.075); the possession annuity stays at the accepted 0.015, ball gain stays 0.05 and both distance terms stay at r0_full. The five k_ terms enter bloodbowl.h:3574-3625 as a linear weighted sum over pre-roll bb_block_ev probabilities, so a uniform halving preserves every relative weight and halves only the block-EV shaping mass. First anneal step outside the distance/possession/ball-gain families (chains 7-11); chained rung, critic intact, never a cold switch (D253/D254).
